answer: New identities post a 50 POA escrow deposit and join a public referral graph. Each epoch, an audit pulse picks K identities for peer review. Any identity whose output has sunk to its nadir — zero genuine work — is slashed, its deposit going to the challenger, and its node turns violet under dispute. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA; star-shaped clusters are flagged. An honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit, and earns full rewards.
